root_cause_evidence.behavior: exec(nvidia-smi ...) every 2 seconds without a child timeout

impact: GPU health probes and TimeLens CUDA calls cannot be considered valid while the host driver is unresponsive.
action: Project jobs stopped; do not launch further GPU inference. Disable or reload the GPU monitor extension and recover the host driver before rerunning G4/G6/G9 real-model gates.
